events.factual_description: Birdland Jazz Club presents the Joe Lovano Nonet from December 1 through December 5, 2026. The official event page lists two sets nightly: 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM Tuesday through Thursday, then 8:30 PM and 10:30 PM Friday and Saturday. Birdland frames the engagement through Lovano's Tenor Legacy concept, created to celebrate major tenor voices of the present while honoring the lineage of the past, and specifically identifies George Garzone and Jerry Bergonzi alongside Leo Genovese, Gerald Cannon and Billy Hart.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because the lineage is in the room, not merely in the program notes. Lovano, George Garzone and Jerry Bergonzi put three deeply individual tenor languages into direct conversation, while Billy Hart adds another living line of jazz history from the drum chair. Birdland's Tenor Legacy framing makes the point explicit: this is about how a tradition is carried, challenged and renewed by musicians with voices strong enough to remain unmistakably themselves.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated DMV-to-New York trip if the dates work, especially for listeners interested in tenor language, improvisational identity and living lineage in a small club. It stays below S+ because this is a five-night residency with ten sets and an active recurring concept rather than a singular one-off, farewell or historically unique reunion.

es.why_it_matters: Esto llega a S porque el linaje está dentro de la sala y no sólo en las notas del programa. Lovano, George Garzone y Jerry Bergonzi ponen tres lenguajes de tenor profundamente individuales en conversación directa, mientras Billy Hart añade otra línea viva de la historia del jazz desde la batería. El marco Tenor Legacy de Birdland hace explícita la idea: se trata de cómo una tradición se carga, se desafía y se renueva por músicos con voces suficientemente fuertes como para seguir siendo inconfundiblemente ellos mismos.
es.trip_verdict: S. Sí vale un viaje dedicado DMV→Nueva York si las fechas cuadran, sobre todo para quien siga lenguaje de tenor, identidad improvisatoria y linaje vivo en una sala pequeña. Se queda debajo de S+ porque es una residencia de cinco noches y diez sets dentro de un concepto activo y recurrente, no un one-off, despedida o reunión históricamente única.
